title: Time picker
description: A time of day, four ways: a list of times step minutes apart, hour and minute columns, segments typed straight into the field, or a grid of slots for bookings. Within min and max, on the locale's 12- or 24-hour clock, and always submits HH:MM. Works with Livewire wire:model, name optional.

consider.note: `min`, `max`, `step` and the slots only limit what's offered. Validate with `date_format:H:i`, and check the time against the same hours on the server. A time alone has no timezone: consider saving it with a date and the person's timezone, or a booking moves by an hour when the clocks change.
With slots for bookings, check the slot is still free when the form arrives, in a transaction with a lock or a unique index: two people can pick the same one at once.
